Company: Brightside Foods Co.

US mid-size packaged food company (~900 employees, plants in Ohio and Georgia). Makes hot dogs and sausages, brightly colored gummy candy, and pecan-and-apple snack bars. Buys pecans, apples and corn from US farms. Sells through grocery chains and convenience stores (many customers pay with SNAP / food stamps). Runs its own fleet of 40 delivery trucks. No restaurants, no alcohol, no exports.

Rules that APPLY:
- FDA food additive and color additive rules (dyes in candy, casings, meat)
- Food labeling and food safety rules for packaged food and meat products
- EPA pesticide residue limits on crops we buy (pecans, apples, corn)
- USDA marketing orders and grading for pecans and apples
- SNAP rules that change what shoppers can buy or who qualifies (affects demand)
- Workplace safety and labor rules for food plants; trucking safety rules for our fleet

Rules that DO NOT apply:
- Aviation, airspace, aircraft airworthiness
- Banking, securities, crypto, sanctions
- Medicare/Medicaid payment rules, medical devices
- Mining, offshore oil and gas, fisheries
- Broadcast/TV licensing

calls.prompt:
Company: Brightside Foods Co.

US mid-size packaged food company (~900 employees, plants in Ohio and Georgia). Makes hot dogs and sausages, brightly colored gummy candy, and pecan-and-apple snack bars. Buys pecans, apples and corn from US farms. Sells through grocery chains and convenience stores (many customers pay with SNAP / food stamps). Runs its own fleet of 40 delivery trucks. No restaurants, no alcohol, no exports.

Rules that APPLY:
- FDA food additive and color additive rules (dyes in candy, casings, meat)
- Food labeling and food safety rules for packaged food and meat products
- EPA pesticide residue limits on crops we buy (pecans, apples, corn)
- USDA marketing orders and grading for pecans and apples
- SNAP rules that change what shoppers can buy or who qualifies (affects demand)
- Workplace safety and labor rules for food plants; trucking safety rules for our fleet

Rules that DO NOT apply:
- Aviation, airspace, aircraft airworthiness
- Banking, securities, crypto, sanctions
- Medicare/Medicaid payment rules, medical devices
- Mining, offshore oil and gas, fisheries
- Broadcast/TV licensing

[2026-21658] Proposed Rule: Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program: Electronic Benefits Transfer Card Security Measures
Tier: Critical (comment deadline in 60 days (< 90))
Owner: Aisha Grant (Sales Compliance)
Why relevant: Proposed SNAP EBT card security rule changes how SNAP payments work at retailers; affects grocery and convenience customers who pay with SNAP and may change retailer requirements and demand.

[2026-21669] Proposed Rule: Hazard Analysis and Risk-Based Preventive Controls for Human Food; Draft Guidance for Industry; Availability
Tier: Medium (proposed rule, comment deadline in 90 days)
Owner: Maria Chen (Food Safety & Regulatory)
Why relevant: FDA draft guidance chapter on control of chemical hazards under preventive controls rule; relevant to hazard analysis for Brightside's packaged food plants (hot dogs, gummies, snack bars), though draft and non-binding.

actions.action: Have Aisha Grant review the proposed food stamp card security changes and file comments, since they could change how our grocery and convenience customers process payments and buy our products.
Ask Maria Chen to compare FDA's draft guidance on chemical hazards with our plant food safety plans and decide whether to comment, since it shapes future inspections.

# Regulatory triage — Brightside Foods Co.
Window 2026-10-19 → 2026-10-23 · as of 2026-10-23 · 2 items

## Critical (1)

- **Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program: Electronic Benefits Transfer Card Security Measures** [Federal Register]
  - Have Aisha Grant review the proposed food stamp card security changes and file comments, since they could change how our grocery and convenience customers process payments and buy our products.
  - Dates: comment 2026-12-22 ✓ · Owner: Aisha Grant (Sales Compliance) · Areas: sales
  - 91 FR 66958 ✓ · https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/10/23/2026-21658/supplemental-nutrition-assistance-program-electronic-benefits-transfer-card-security-measures

## Medium (1)
